description: Source code for a Python script that manages test modules and generates a test suite configuration, including classes for handling modules, templates, and test suite operations.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a test module with methods to parse test functions, render templates, and refresh its state from a file.

classes.name: TestSuite
classes.description: Manages collection of modules, determines if regeneration is needed, loads/saves cache, and writes the test suite configuration.

methods.name: Module.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Module with a name.

methods.name: Module.clean_name
methods.description: Converts underscores in the module name to double colons.

methods.name: Module._skip_comments
methods.description: Removes comments from source code text.

methods.name: Module.parse
methods.description: Parses test function definitions from source code contents.

methods.name: Module.refresh
methods.description: Updates module state from a file, re-parsing if modified.

methods.name: TestSuite.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a TestSuite with a path and output directory.

methods.name: TestSuite.should_generate
methods.description: Determines if the test suite should be regenerated.

methods.name: TestSuite.find_modules
methods.description: Finds test modules in the specified path.

methods.name: TestSuite.save_cache
methods.description: Saves current module data to cache.

methods.name: TestSuite.suite_count
methods.description: Returns total number of test suites.

methods.name: TestSuite.write
methods.description: Generates the test suite configuration file.
